subject: Request: One-off pilot renewal & additional credits for CloudSprint
messages:
From: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@cloudsprint.com>
To: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@cloudsprint.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline and usage

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week — the team is excited. We pushed a wider test to two additional product teams and usage spiked unexpectedly. Because of that, we need more runtime credits and a short extension to the pilot window so we can complete a second integration.

Could Redwood provide a one-off additional credit pool (approx. 250k tokens) and a 2-week extension to our pilot? Procurement will also want a short statement of terms to attach to their internal review.

If possible, we can sign a quick addendum or an MOU; otherwise, please advise next steps.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — this expansion is closely tied to our Q1 roadmap.

Best,
Sarah Jenkins
Head of Integrations, CloudSprint
---
CloudSprint | sarah.jenkins@cloudsprint.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@cloudsprint.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@cloudsprint.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot timeline and usage

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for the note and congrats on the expanded test. I can escalate this to Deal Desk and leadership to request a one-off grant and extension. Couple quick asks to speed review:

- Can you confirm anticipated additional token consumption (best estimate is fine)?
- Which two product teams / integrations are in scope (short sentence each)?
- Are you able to sign a brief addendum (we can prefill) or do you need procurement approval first?

I pulled a usage snapshot and attached a short report that summarizes the pilot run so far. I will escalate and aim to get a decision today or tomorrow.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
Attachments: POC_usage_report.pdf (pdf)

From: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@cloudsprint.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 11:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot timeline and usage — escalation request (CloudSprint / RWI-78912)

Forwarding — CloudSprint expanded their pilot to two additional product teams and needs extra credits + a short extension to finish integration testing. Quick summary and ask below.

Summary:
- Account: CloudSprint (pipeline motion; PM-led evaluation; likely pilots to paid contract if results hold)
- Current pilot: 4 weeks remaining, consumption ramped ~3x in last 48h
- Customer ask: one-off additional credits ~250k tokens and 2-week extension to pilot window
- Business rationale: Customer cites Q1 roadmap dependency; product teams likely to convert to paid usage if integration succeeds; estimated 18–24 month ARR opportunity if pilot converts

Attachments: POC_usage_report.pdf, Signed-Mutual-Action-Plan.docx (MOU they signed earlier)

Ask: Approve an exception to standard PLG limits (one-off credit + extension). If full ask is not approved, request guidance on fallback (e.g., smaller credit + short extension) and any required contract language. Also need approval path for non-standard term tracking (deal id above).

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call.

—Sean

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 12:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot timeline and usage — escalation request (CloudSprint / RWI-78912)

Sean —

Thanks for the concise note and the attachments. I reviewed the usage snapshot and the MOU. We try to avoid one-off exceptions at scale, but this looks like a reasonable early-stage opportunity with clear expansion signals.

I can approve a limited exception now: 100k tokens + 1-week extension, conditional on:

- Customer signs a 1-page addendum (we provide) acknowledging the one-off grant and agreeing to quick procurement timeline;
- CS (Monica) is scheduled for an onboarding session within next 3 business days to drive adoption;
- We capture the win in deal tracking under deal_id RWI-78912 and attach the MOU/addendum to the HubSpot record.

If the customer needs the full 250k/2-weeks, we should escalate to Rishi for final approval. Sean, please ask Sarah to confirm if they can accept the conditional 100k/1-week while we pursue exec approval for the remainder.

—Aditya

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@cloudsprint.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 09:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot timeline and usage — escalation request (CloudSprint / RWI-78912)

Looping in a quick decision here. CloudSprint is a credible early enterprise buyer and the ARR upside described is meaningful. I'm comfortable approving a one-off grant with controls. Final approval:

- Grant: 200,000 tokens one-off credit
- Extension: 2-week pilot window extension
- Conditions: Must sign our one-page addendum (I reviewed the language; Sean/Legal to prep), CS (Monica) to run two onboarding sessions and capture success metrics, and Deal Desk to mark this as a non-standard term under RWI-78912 for post-mortem.

Also no discounts on list price outside the pilot; any commercial discounting requires a separate procurement approval. Please document the addendum and get sign-off from procurement.

Rishi
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Jenkins <sarah.jenkins@cloudsprint.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@cloudsprint.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, procurement@cloudsprint.com
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 14:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Approved: one-off pilot credits & 2-week extension (CloudSprint / RWI-78912)

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Good news: leadership has approved a one-off credit of 200,000 tokens and a 2-week extension to your pilot, conditional on the one-page addendum and two CS onboarding sessions. Next steps below:

1) Legal/Sean: I will send the addendum template by EOD; please review and confirm procurement path.
2) CS/Monica: Monica will reach out to schedule two onboarding sessions in the next 3 business days.
3) Customer: Once addendum is signed, we will apply the 200k credit and extend your pilot window.

Attached: copy of the usage snapshot we reviewed. I will also share a DocuSign link for the addendum in a follow-up.

Thanks for moving quickly — we’re excited to see the integration outcomes.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
Attachments: POC_usage_report.pdf; DocuSign: https://rwi.docusign.com/envelopes/ABC-123-CloudSprint
